title: Erato Praeludium
opus: Muse of poetry, erotic poetry in particular (Erato)
studyTransform: Upper MIDI track; highest note at simultaneous onsets; first 32 bars; durations quantized to sixteenth notes. Accompaniment and performance markings omitted.
sourceLabel: Mutopia Project · edition and public-domain declaration
rights: The composition and this Mutopia edition are supplied as Public Domain. Edition source: Unknown. The included PDF and original MIDI are unchanged. The editable notation is a 15-bar upper-part study (maximum 32 bars) derived from the MIDI, not the complete score.
description: Baroque music for Harpsichord, Piano. Complete source PDF plus an editable upper-part practice study.
attribution: J. K. F. Fischer (1665–1746); Rune Zedeler
compositionStatus: Public-domain composition and edition as declared by source
